title: Congressman Nick LaLota addresses trade issues and local initiatives
text:
U.S. Rep. Nick Lalota, District 1 | Facebook Website
U.S. Rep. Nick Lalota, District 1 | Facebook Website
Congressman Nick LaLota, representing New York's 1st district since 2023, recently shared his views and legislative efforts through a series of tweets. Born in Bay Shore, New York in 1978, LaLota now resides in Amityville. He succeeded Lee Zeldin in Congress.
On July 8, 2025, Congressman LaLota expressed concerns over China's trade practices. He stated that "China’s rise has relied on unfair trade—IP theft, market manipulation, and underpriced exports." He emphasized his commitment to "level the playing field," aiming to protect jobs on Long Island and preserve the American Dream.
The following day, on July 9, 2025, LaLota highlighted his work on legislation benefiting Long Island residents. He noted that "We stood strong against gimmicks and politics to deliver direct, measurable relief for Long Island." Referring to a specific piece of legislation as "The One Big Beautiful Bill," he assured constituents of its effectiveness.
Later on July 9th, Congressman LaLota addressed military and veteran issues based on his own experience as a Navy Veteran. He mentioned advocating for increased funding by saying "I fought for a 3% funding boost in this year’s MilConVA bill—to tackle homelessness, expand mental health care & support military families with better childcare."
Nick LaLota has been actively engaged in legislative matters impacting both local constituents and broader national interests since taking office.
